title: The BMC does not correctly enforce integrity and encryption requirements for IPMI commands. (CVE-2026-18449)
description: The Baseboard Management Controller (BMC) fails to properly enforce integrity and encryption requirements for IPMI commands. This vulnerability allows an attacker to craft malicious packets that could execute arbitrary commands on an active session without requiring privileges or user interaction. The issue poses a high security risk due to the potential for unauthorized command execution.
